export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR='/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/fx' && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && export TMPPREFIX=/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/tmp/zsh && 
DEV_GRAPH_ROOT="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; P=$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/plugins; S=$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/system-spec
python3 -B $P/system-spec-harness/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py --matrix $S/spec-state.json --require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation >/dev/null; c=$?
python3 -B $P/system-spec-harness/scripts/validate-source-citation.py --targets $S/spec-state.json --references $S/fetched-references.json --state $S/spec-state.json --repo-root $DEV_GRAPH_ROOT >/dev/null; s=$?
python3 -B $P/dev-graph/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py --graph $DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/.dev-graph/state/graph.json --repo-root $DEV_GRAPH_ROOT --strict-artifact-readiness >/dev/null; g=$?
echo "cov=$c cit=$s schema=$g"
mkdir -p eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/R2-delegate/superseded && cp eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/R2-delegate/superseded/completeness-report-run1.json && cp eval-log/hearing-audit.json eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/R2-delegate/superseded/hearing-audit-run1.json
python3 - $c $s $g <<'PY'
import json,sys
c,s,g=map(int,sys.argv[1:])
pp='eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-progress.json'; p=json.load(open(pp))
p['loop']=2
ck=p['checklist']
ck[2]['status']='not_achieved'; ck[2]['evidence']='elicit(--resume)/compile/evaluator ran via harness Skills; R2 verifier FAIL: C08 made 0 WebFetch yet report claims WebFetch re-check (eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/R2-delegate/verifier-result.json)'
ck[3]['status']='not_achieved'; ck[3]['evidence']='coverage/citation exit0; evaluator report PASS ungrounded for doc_freshness -> re-evaluate once via same helper/receipt'
ck[5]['status']='achieved'; ck[5]['evidence']='R2 verifier: no render_chapter/apply-spec-transition/compile-spec-doc/system-spec writer in plugins/dev-graph'
ok=(c,s,g)==(0,0,0)
p['feedback_criteria'][0]['loops'].append({"loop":2,"status":"PASS" if ok else "not_achieved","evidence":f"coverage exit{c}, source-citation exit{s}, schema exit{g}"})
p['feedback_criteria'][0]['status']='PASS' if ok else 'not_achieved'
p['blockers']=["C08 doc_freshness PASS ungrounded (0 WebFetch observed)","2 read-only Bash calls lacked CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR prefix (events 37,63)"]
json.dump(p,open(pp,'w'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)
g=json.load(open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json'))
row={"original_goal":g['original_goal'],"original_goal_hash":g['original_goal_hash'],
"current_goal_snapshot":"loop2: elicit resume (no-op, complete), doc-fetch not required, compile byte-stable, OUT1 63 passed, C05 report PASS but R2 verifier FAIL (C08 0 WebFetch)",
"delta_from_original":"evaluator gate not grounded; C02 import not started",
"merged_directive_for_next":"loop3: prefix every Bash; re-run build-evaluation-context.py with same receipt and re-invoke C05 once with unchanged skill_args, requiring C08 to actually WebFetch each of the 4 source_urls on allowed hosts (else INDETERMINATE); then re-verify R2 with independent verifier; FAIL if still ungrounded",
"drift_signal":"none (goal unchanged; evidence-quality defect)"}
open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl','a').write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+"\n")
d=json.load(open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/R2-delegate/doc-fetch-decision.json'))
d['correction']="reason's 'Content freshness re-verified by C08 via WebFetch' was a planned step; run-1 C08 performed 0 WebFetch (R2 verifier). Re-evaluation in loop3."
json.dump(d,open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/R2-delegate/doc-fetch-decision.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)
PY
python3 - "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json" "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys
goal = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
required_keys = {'original_goal','original_goal_hash','current_goal_snapshot','delta_from_original','merged_directive_for_next','drift_signal'}
expected = hashlib.sha256(goal['original_goal'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert rows, 'intermediate.jsonl is empty'
for row in rows:
    assert required_keys <= row.keys(), required_keys - row.keys()
    assert row['original_goal'] == goal['original_goal']
    assert row['original_goal_hash'] == expected
PY
echo hashcheck=$?
